note: Human-labeled paraphrase / cross-lingual query set for the semantic blog search. Each query is deliberately NOT a substring of its target post(s) — English queries force cross-lingual matching, Japanese ones paraphrase. Keys are '<member_key>/<post_id>'. A query may have several genuinely relevant posts (e.g. every member's first blog post). Absolute scores are pessimistic: only the listed targets count as hits, so any unlabelled-but-relevant post counts as a miss — penalties hit every model equally, so the comparison stays fair.
